title: symplocos cochinchinensis var. orbicularis
intro: Symplocos cochinchinensis var. orbicularis, commonly known as the East Indian Symplocos, is a plant species belonging to the family Symplocaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Symplocos cochinchinensis var. orbicularis include lowering blood pressure, reducing fever, and acting as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
